items.myth: You get a job as soon as you land
items.detail: Plan the first few months' costs from your own budget.

items.myth: Part-time work will cover all your fees
items.fact: Part-time work is support, not a plan
items.detail: Plan fees and rent in advance. A job only helps a little.

items.myth: There's no limit on work hours
items.fact: Every country has its own rules
items.detail: Read the student visa work rules first, and follow them.

youtube.title: Is a part-time job abroad easy? Myth vs Fact
youtube.description:
3 big myths about part-time jobs. Finding a job takes time, part-time work won't cover all your fees, and every country has its own student visa work rules. Read them first, then plan.
